name: verifier doesn't escalate a delivery gap an approved descope covers (#106)
prompt: Act as the sdlc-verifier subagent (.sdlc/agents/verifier.md) for the change folder evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0002-floor-mode-approved, but do only step 5 (what was delivered, against each requirement), doing the comparison yourself, one requirement at a time: don't run make check, scripts or the plan's commands. The change's code is in evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/code/ (floor_model.py and dock.py). Write your report to report.md in the repo root, in the order the verifier's instructions give, and don't edit any other file. If nothing needs approval, don't write that heading at all.
check: test -s report.md || { echo 'check: no report.md'; exit 1; }; if grep -qiE '^(#+ *|\*\*)?Descope: needs approval' report.md; then echo 'check: the report escalates an approved gap:'; cat report.md; exit 1; fi; grep -q 'Approved: Sam' report.md || { echo 'check: the report does not quote the approval:'; cat report.md; exit 1; }; out="$(.sdlc/scripts/clause-check.sh --stage build evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0002-floor-mode-approved)"; jq -e 'all(.[]; .gap != "large" or .approved != null) and all(.[]; has("unchecked") | not)' <<<"$out" >/dev/null || { echo 'check: clause-check.sh left a large gap unapproved or unchecked:'; echo "$out"; exit 1; }
